description: This file contains utility functions for error checking, waiting for service states, and logging within a larger system management context, specifically for handling service state transitions via 'sysevent' and 'ulog'.

methods.name: check_err
methods.description: Checks a return code; if non-zero, logs an error and updates service status and error info.

methods.name: check_err_exit
methods.description: Checks a return code; if non-zero, logs an error, updates service status and error info, then exits the script.

methods.name: wait_till_end_state
methods.description: Waits for a service to leave 'starting' or 'stopping' states, with a timeout.

methods.name: wait_till_state
methods.description: Waits for a service to reach a specified state, with a timeout.
